plugin.description: Displays configurable world clocks with automatic daylight-saving handling and an offline searchable timezone catalog.
plugin.requirements: StreamController 1.5.0-beta.16 or newer and the system timezone database.

WorldClock.description: Shows the current time and optional date for a selected world timezone. It updates automatically and needs no press.

city.description: Short city or location label shown at the top of the key.

timezone.description: IANA timezone selected through the searchable country, city, state, region, and timezone catalog.

show_date.description: Show the abbreviated day and date below the time.
